'''Keraille Surtovni''' is one of the [[Kin]].

== Appearance ==
She is short and slim with tilted green eyes and fiery red curls.

== History ==
Her combination of tilted eyes and typical [[Kandori]] surname suggests a [[Borderlander]] origin. However, she looked more like a [[Saldaea]]n.

Her Saidar strength is {{opsl|55}}, a very low level by Aes Sedai standards. She is four levels below the minimum to be tested for Aes Sedai.

== Activities ==
She and [[Derys Nermala|Derys]] leave Ebou Far for the Kin's farm the day after the Feast of the Half Moon, where they were swept up in the escape from the Seanchan.

She is one of the Kin assigned to look after the captive ''[[sul'dam]]'' in [[Caemlyn]].

She is sent with [[Julanya Fote|Julanya]] to watch and report on any movement the neutral [[High Seat]]s armies may make.

They [[Travel]] back to Caemlyn to report to [[Birgitte Silverbow]] that the army is moving towards the city. Then they are sent back to their camp posing as laundresses.
